# MicroCD Labs

> MicroCD Labs supports diagnostic, life-sciences, and laboratory-product teams with microfluidic systems, cartridges, consumables, lab-on-disc development, engineering design, prototype coordination, supplier identification, verification planning, and technical commercialization work.

MicroCD Labs is a division of Karigari Home LLC. Website content describes research-use products, technical capabilities, software tools, and early product-development support. It does not claim regulatory approval, clinical validation, certified manufacturing, or laboratory accreditation.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.microcdlabs.com/): Company positioning, development focus, and contact options
- [Services](https://www.microcdlabs.com/services.html): Microfluidic and diagnostic product-development capabilities
- [Diagnostics](https://www.microcdlabs.com/diagnostics.html): Assay development, LFIA, lab-on-disc, and kinetic-analysis focus
- [OEM workflows](https://www.microcdlabs.com/automation.html): Microfluidic equipment integration and end-user workflow support
- [Products](https://www.microcdlabs.com/products.html): Research-use parts, consumables, kits, and equipment catalog
- [Microfluidic chips](https://www.microcdlabs.com/microfluidic-chips/): PDMS, glass, COC, PMMA, functional chips, and custom chip-development options
- [Microfluidic tubing](https://www.microcdlabs.com/microfluidic-tubing/): PTFE, FEP, PEEK, silicone, Tygon, and microbore tubing selection
- [Fittings and connectors](https://www.microcdlabs.com/microfluidic-fittings-connectors/): Luer, barbed, compression, PEEK, manifold, and reservoir interfaces
- [Lab-on-CD Platform](https://www.microcdlabs.com/lab-on-cd-platform.html): Centrifugal microfluidics, disc consumables, assays, instrumentation, software, and a staged development vision toward future point-of-care workflows
- [Pumps and flow control](https://www.microcdlabs.com/microfluidic-pumps-flow-control/): Syringe and peristaltic pumps, pressure controllers, valves, and sensors
- [Lateral flow assay materials](https://www.microcdlabs.com/lateral-flow-assay-materials/): Membranes, pads, housings, consumables, and development support
- [MicroCD SonoMap](https://www.microcdlabs.com/products/sonomap/): Early-stage phone-connected ultrasound concept for directional tissue-mapping research
- [About](https://www.microcdlabs.com/about.html): Founder background and areas of technical experience
- [News](https://www.microcdlabs.com/news.html): Research, software, and company updates
- [Technical consultation](https://www.microcdlabs.com/consultation.html): Non-confidential project inquiry

## Software tools

- [MicroCD LabOps](https://labops.microcdlabs.com/): Engineering documentation and supplier traceability workspace
- [Microfluidic Modeler](https://www.microcdlabs.com/platform.html): Cartridge geometry and early design workspace
- [Kinetic Assay Enhancer](https://www.microcdlabs.com/analyzer/): Time-series assay image and kinetic-feature analysis
